shortDescription: Mitsubishi TSE:8058 will raise its economic stake in Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp PSE:AC to 15% in a 44.5 billion Philippine peso ($709.48 million) deal to deepen the Japanese trading house’s partnership in the Philippines, the latter said on Monday.($1 = 62.7220 Philippine pesos)
